_comment: Copy to config.json. Paths are relative to the project root. Earlier entries win when the same file exists in several places.
_comment_manifests: Where this setup's asset manifests live. Defaults shown; only these are used, nothing else in the project.
_comment_fallback: Optional, off by default: another region's manifests to fill gaps from. Their files may carry that region's language (e.g. English banners in a Japanese build).

en._comment: Optional: the other language's app-data backup (e.g. the global one's contents/1/master/divide_novel_command_enc) for two-language subtitles: decrypt_all.py --lang en, then build_web.py. Only novel_dirs is needed.
